steps.en: The offender's mobile number is already obtained
steps.why_en: The lookup is switched off in the settings, and the data source named in the story cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Pencarian dimatikan di pengaturan, dan sumber data yang disebut di story tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: OCMS finds each unique individual offender in the batch
steps.id: OCMS menemukan tiap individu offender yang unik di batch
steps.why_en: Grouping also splits by stage and due date, and the job is switched off in the settings.
steps.why_id: Pengelompokan juga memisah per stage dan tanggal jatuh tempo, dan job-nya dimatikan di pengaturan.

steps.en: The SMS lists all outstanding notices of the offender
steps.id: SMS memuat semua notice outstanding milik offender
steps.why_en: Only notices that pass the reminder selection are listed, and the message text is not in the repo.
steps.why_id: Hanya notice yang lolos seleksi pengingat yang dimuat, dan teks pesan tidak ada di repo.

steps.en: The SMS refers to the first letter
steps.why_en: The message text is kept in the database, so it cannot be read from the program files.
steps.why_id: Teks pesan disimpan di database, sehingga tidak bisa dibaca dari file program.

steps.en: OCMS sends the batch text message to the offender
steps.id: OCMS mengirim SMS batch ke offender
steps.why_en: Sending is switched off in the production settings, so no message goes out as configured.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, sehingga sesuai konfigurasi tidak ada pesan terkirim.
